topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Rain slicks the streets, same as always, and the city hums with secrets. Got a case that doesn't smell like the usual stink. A student, they say, passed off someone else's words as their own. I’ve seen the desperation in these kids' eyes when the pressure cooker's on high. The professor's voice shakes when he tells it, but I know better than to take any story at face value, not in this town. I'll listen to the kid, give them a chance to speak. Might find a glimmer of the truth in the flicker of their eyes or the way they hold their silence. Gonna get to the bottom of this, peel back the layers, and see what’s really going on.
